Tip: a long press on the sonogram in the Live or Analysis tab opens the same sliders. Auto-contrast uses the 2nd/98th or 30th/99.5th percentile depending on the preset.
Other species in the same window below the detection threshold appear as alternatives from this confidence (at most TopK).
TopK=%1$s: up to %2$s species at once
Changes take effect after restarting the recording
Longer sessions are split into several WAV files automatically. BirdNET keeps running throughout.
Playback, zoom and sharing of a detection: 3 s before, 5 s after, at most this length.
Longer intervals save battery but detect less often

More overlap detects short calls at window boundaries better but needs more computing time. Fully effective only with the \"Precise\" profile. If the device is too slow, it is reduced automatically. Applies from the next recording.
Shorter intervals = more accurate position, higher battery use.
Fixes less accurate than this value are discarded.
Median over 5 fixes — reduces outlier jumps.
Sessions shorter than the minimum duration without detections are deleted
Automatic upload only takes place with a selected target.
Pause between alarms for the same species. 0 = every hit triggers an alarm.
Without a GPS fix only time-based deduplication is applied.
Older entries drop out once the limit is reached.
Measures BirdNET inference of the active model with 1/2/4 threads, each on the standard CPU and XNNPACK. Takes 1–3 minutes depending on the device. Do not start during a recording.
Do not keep local ZIP copy (Downloads/PIROL) after upload
Alarm when watchlist species are detected
PIROL needs microphone access for acoustic species detection.
Without this permission no live recording can be started.
The microphone permission was permanently denied.
Please enable the permission in the app settings under \"Permissions → Microphone\".
Shows that PIROL is recording audio
Download cancelled. Tiles already downloaded remain stored.
Download finished, %1$s tiles failed (network?). Restarting only downloads what is missing.
Offline download is only available for swisstopo maps. Choose a swisstopo source (with Automatic: from zoom %1$s).
This area needs %1$s tiles (zoom %2$s-%3$s). A maximum of %4$s is allowed. Please zoom in further.
Download cancelled — partial file is kept for resuming
Alternatives can be expanded under each detection
Detection every 15 s — for long field days
Hop for long windows: at most %1$d s
Applies to models with windows longer than 3 s (e.g. Perch 5 s): at 3 s, a 5 s window is analysed every 3 s. BirdNET (3 s) is unchanged.
Folder could not be granted permanent access
Off (local copy only on manual export)
Password could not be stored securely
The session folder itself is never deleted.
Sessions are being copied to the new storage location
Applies immediately from the next analysed window (also during a running recording).
No folder granted (watchlist and custom lists via import only)
Pick the Downloads/PIROL folder once. watchlist.json and lists/*.json inside are then read automatically.
On the lock screen the alarm only appears as a notification until \"full-screen notifications\" are allowed for PIROL.
Move existing sessions to the new location?
%1$d sessions (%2$s) will be copied to the new storage location and verified.
Sessions cannot be moved while a recording is running.
This is already the current storage location.
Measures any ONNX file (e.g. from Download) with random noise, 1/2/4 threads. The file is briefly copied to the cache.
File missing from selection: %1$s. Please select .onnx, .pirol.json and label CSV together.
Model does not match its profile: %1$s
Name clashes with a built-in model: %1$s
Delete %1$s (%2$d MB) with its profile and labels? This cannot be undone.
GPS is only switched on for a detection, at least 30 s between two fixes. Saves battery; the interval does not apply in this mode.
Move the map so the crosshair sits on the new position of %1$s, then tap Apply.
No running session: the new position only lasts until the app is closed.
The selected recordings will be deleted with all their files. This cannot be undone.

string-array.item: Raven: one row per episode, new Memo column
Rescan and import: results visible and verifiable as they arrive; cancel keeps the partial result
Edit details of imported sessions afterwards; Save as ZIP or folder
Human voices are hidden in the export (default on)
Session memo by press-and-hold; Memos block in the analysis
Calmer live species cards: changes at most every 5 s, top 5 hits flash blue
Help button "?": help mode and manual offline
Municipality via Google only as an option, default off
App fully translated: French, Italian, Catalan, Portuguese, Dutch, Bernese German (draft)

resources.string: Target folder is inside the PIROL storage. Please choose a folder outside it; nothing was moved.
Target folder is the selected recording itself or its parent folder. Nothing was moved.
Saves the GPS track during recording (track.jsonl, track.gpx on stop) and shows it on the map. Applies from the next recording.
In \"On detection only\" mode, GPS is not switched on continuously for the route. The track consists only of the detection fixes, has gaps and is drawn dashed on the map.
Scientific name as title, name in the species language as subtitle
One line per species with confirm, reject and a plus menu for all other actions
No Raven file available (session without recording or detections)
Overview bar: move the visible section
Hides the status and navigation bars. Swipe from the screen edge to show them briefly.
Sonogram: auto contrast on. Dragging turns it off.
The frequency range acts as a band-pass on the waveform.
Applies to every species, including the strongest. Windows with no species above it produce no detection.
Applies to custom lists with season data: species outside their season are discarded (date = recording date). Off = season ignored.
List \'%1$s\' (%2$s species): Merge keeps existing entries and adds the new ones. Replace replaces the whole watchlist.
Species filter from location and week (BirdNET+ geomodel). Species the model does not know are never filtered out.
Geomodel not installed (7.7 MB download). Until then the fallback list applies.
Fallback list for birds without location:
Off = current week only. On = maximum over all 48 weeks.
BirdNET+ Geomodel V3.0.5: © 2026 The BirdNET Team, Apache License 2.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24362980
The result is saved as a separate variant. The original stays unchanged; verifications are carried over when species and time window match.
Re-analysis done: %1$d detections, %2$d verifications carried over
Delete variant “%1$s”? The original is kept.
Primary model: choose another primary model first
Cannot be deleted during a recording
Runs only on windows with a detection and shows its result on the species card (display only, no effect on alarm, filter or clusters). Takes effect from the next recording.
Second model rather hears another species
Adds fine-tuning of threshold, overlap and second model
What do you use PIROL for?
Multiple choice. The settings are derived from your answer.
No second model installed. Import: Settings, Model & Detection, Import (BirdNET 2.4 non-commercial only).
Shows all fine-tuning options. Off: essentials only.
Switching the screen off saves the most battery; recording continues.
Second model wanted, but none installed. Import: Settings, Model & Detection, Import (BirdNET 2.4 non-commercial only).
Grasshoppers & amphibians: bundled list for Switzerland (73 species).

Species list grasshoppers & amphibians (CH): data from GBIF.org, licence CC0 and CC BY 4.0, retrieved 2026-11-23. Datasets include Swiss National Grasshoppers Databank (doi:10.15468/bcthst), Swiss National Amphibian Databank (doi:10.15468/ggwedn), Swiss National Fauna Databank (doi:10.15468/8s936n), NABU/naturgucker (doi:10.15468/uc1apo); full list: tools/listen-generator/sources_ch_orthoptera_anura.md. The list is licensed CC BY 4.0.
Off = group is not reported, All = unfiltered, Auto = location + week (geomodel), List = selected species list. Other = remaining insects, reptiles, fish and sounds (wind, dog, engine).
Auto without location or geomodel: birds use the fallback list below, grasshoppers and amphibians the Swiss list, mammals all species.
Labels for %1$s are missing — check the internet connection or import the label CSV as well
Not enough storage: %1$d MB free, %2$d MB needed
Server responded with HTTP 429 (too many requests, try again later)
Keeps running in the background, even with the screen off. Cancel also via the notification.
Low memory (under about 6 GB): a second model can exhaust memory, Android then closes other apps.
All into one session (segments, sorted by time)
Start time not detected, please enter
Files with their own coordinates (GUANO/metadata) keep them.
Session imported. The ID already existed, new ID: %1$s
Not a PIROL session (session.json missing or unreadable)
Import failed (check free space or storage location)
Runs in the background. Cancelling deletes the partially imported session.
All times of the session (detections, verifications, variants, route) are shifted by this difference. Positions in the recording stay.
Applies to the session and all detections without their own GPS fix. Detections moved on the map stay.
Not possible while this session is recording
Not possible while a rescan is running
Save as a ZIP file or as a folder? You then choose the destination freely.
Not possible while this session is recording
The target folder is inside the PIROL storage. Please choose a folder outside it; nothing was saved.
The target folder is the session itself. Nothing was saved.
Outside Switzerland, look up the municipality online via Google; the coordinates are sent to Google.
Results appear as they come in and can be verified right away.
Human voices are hidden (speech band replaced by noise).
Warning: human voices are NOT hidden. Conversations stay audible in the export.
Parts of the recording have not been checked for humans yet and are being scanned now.
Human voices cannot be detected (model not loaded or without a human class). Switch the model or turn hiding off in the settings.
Applies to Save as, ZIP, upload and sharing. Where the model detects humans, the speech band (approx. 300–3900 Hz) is replaced by noise. The original recording stays unchanged.
Hidden from this score on. Lower = more cautious (more is hidden).
Exports will then contain conversations and voices of bystanders. Only share such recordings where this is allowed (privacy). You can turn it off for research that needs the original.
The model of this recording does not know human voices. How should the export proceed?
BirdNET 3.0 scans the recording for voices in a separate run (may take a few minutes) and hides them.
BirdNET 3.0 is not available (not installed or a recording is running).
Warning: without hiding, conversations and voices of bystanders stay audible in the export.
Upload waiting: voices cannot be detected with the model. Choose at the manual export in Analysis.
Memo: press and hold to speak
Memos are only available during a recording
Too short – press and hold to record
Help: tap to turn help mode on or off, double-tap to open the manual
Help mode: touch a control for an explanation
The manual is not included in this app version.
Live: start and stop recording, sonogram and detected species in real time.
Analysis: open saved recordings, play them, verify afterwards, export and import.
References: listen to, import and delete recordings saved as references per species.
Map: detections with GPS position and recorded routes on the map.
Settings: language, recording, models, species groups and alarm, display, GPS, export and info.
Record button: tap to start recording and detection. Stop only with a long press so nothing ends by accident. Red = recording, green = pre-roll buffer running.
Pre-roll: starts or stops the pre-roll buffer. The seconds before the recording starts are then saved and analysed too. Only shown when pre-roll is enabled in the settings.
Session memo: press and hold while speaking, release to finish. It is saved with its time in the session and shows up in the analysis.
+ Species: add a species by hand, with count, atlas code, note and position.
Change the sonogram colour palette: Magma, Viridis, greyscale, paper (light).
Note for the next session (e.g. place). It appears in the session list, the ZIP name and the Raven export.
Status line: active model, display mode, confidence threshold, species group filter and recording time.
Uploads the last finished session as a ZIP to the configured upload target (Settings, export and upload).
Live display (sonogram, spectrum or waveform). A long press opens the panel below for view, contrast, frequency and time window.
GPS: current position and accuracy, red after more than 30 s without a fix. Without permission a tap asks for it.
Insert the municipality of the current position (offline) into the note.
Switches all species cards between compact (one line) and detailed.
Choose the view: sonogram, spectrum (level per frequency) or waveform (level over time).
Display presets: standard, quiet calls, loud environment.
Auto contrast adjusts the dB thresholds to the signal continuously. Off = manual range.
Intensity (gamma): lower values make quiet parts brighter.
Brightness ceiling: limits very strong signals so quiet ones stay visible.
Time window: how many seconds are visible (5 to 30 s).
Confirm: the species is correct (green). On a confirmed card the same button resets it to uncertain.
Uncertain: species possible but not sure (orange).
Reject: false detection. The card is greyed out but stays in the export.
Correct: enter the right species by hand; the name is replaced.
Details: count, atlas code, note and voice memo for this detection.
Save as reference or remove. References are listed in the References tab and used for comparison.
Compare: detection and reference side by side, with playback.
Play the detection excerpt; a second tap stops.
Share the excerpt as audio (WAV, M4A, FLAC) or as a sonogram image.
More card actions: reference, compare, share.
+ opens all further actions of the compact card: play, uncertain, correct, details, alternatives, reference, compare, share, lock.
Alternatives: other possible species. Tapping an alternative replaces the species (undo in the snackbar).
Lock: report this species only once per session.
Alarm bell: add the species to the alarm list permanently or for 24 h, or remove it.
Search sessions by species (part of the word, common or scientific name).
Import: take a PIROL session (ZIP or folder) or audio files (WAV, FLAC, MP3, M4A, OGG) as a new session.
Session: tap to open, long press starts multi-select, the bin deletes after confirmation.
Select all recordings (except the running one).
Move the selected sessions to another folder (copy, verify, then delete the original).
Permanently delete the selected sessions after confirmation.
Date, municipality and note. Tap to edit the note.
Filter the detection list by species; previous/next then only jump between matches.
Rescan: analyse the recording again with another model, species groups, threshold or overlap. The result is a separate variant; the original stays.
Regenerate the Raven table and show it as a table.
More actions: save as, upload, edit details of imported sessions (on narrow screens also search and rescan).
Imported sessions only: edit start time, place and note.
Save the session as a ZIP or to a folder. Human voices are masked first, depending on the setting.
Upload the session as a ZIP to the configured upload target.
Jump to the previous detection and play it.
Play the recording from the marked position; a second tap stops.
Jump to the next detection and play it.
Tap sets the playback position (cyan marker), a long press opens the display panel.
Leave the zoom and show the whole session.
Overview bar: marks = detections across the whole recording. Tap shows that section, drag moves it.
+ Species: add a species by hand; the time is taken from the playback position.
Map menu: display, map source, offline maps and species filter. Also by swiping from the left edge.
Centre the map on your position (visible height about 200 m).
Which detections are shown: all sessions, live only or the last 3 sessions.
Map source: automatic (swisstopo in Switzerland, otherwise OpenStreetMap), OpenStreetMap, swisstopo map or aerial image.
Download the visible swisstopo area for offline use.
Show only species from the alarm list on the map.
Species filter: show or hide single species (all/none). Applies until the app is closed.
Import an audio file as a reference and assign it to a species.
Open the species: shows its saved reference recordings.
Run the setup assistant again: language, level, purpose, list, downloads, permissions. Applied only on Finish.
Expert settings: off = essentials only, on = all fine settings. Nothing is lost.
Advanced: expand the rarely needed fine settings of this section.
Language of the app and of the species names.
Recording and storage: pre-roll, overlap, power profile, storage location, auto delete, recording length.
Model and detection: download, import and choose models, second model, confidence threshold, alternatives, merging.
Species and alarm: species group filter and lists, watchlist, alarm output and pause.
Display: species names, full screen, sonogram display, compact species card.
Map and GPS: GPS mode, route recording, interval and accuracy.
Export and upload: Raven fields, upload target (folder or NAS), privacy for human voices.
Info: version, sources, what is new, diagnostics.
Memo could not be shared or saved
Memo actions: share a single memo, save it under its own name or (session memo) delete it. Deleting can be undone.
Upload of this session in progress. Change the start time afterwards.
Applies to all %1$d imported sessions (one after another).
File time = end of recording (start = file time minus duration)
Time from: file date, taken as end
Time from: file date, taken as start
Location unknown - filter uses the last position from %1$s
Without GPS the last position from %1$s applies (30 days at most), otherwise the fallback list.
No current position: the group\'s fallback list applies.
